contract: GET /auth/openid. Start the enabled OIDC web or native authorization flow, preserving state, PKCE, callback validation, configured router base path and redirect/cookie fields used by clients; disabled/invalid flows deny without issuing credentials.

invariants.contract: A web start (GET /auth/openid?callback=<same-origin URL under the router base path>) answers 302 to the configured authorization endpoint with the configured client_id, response_type=code, scope 'openid profile email', a random state, redirect_uri=<request origin>/auth/openid/callback and a 43-character S256 code_challenge; it sets HttpOnly auth_cb=<callback> with Max-Age 600, HttpOnly auth_method=openid with Max-Age 315360000 and an express session cookie, and carries no token material. A native start (response_type=code, redirect_uri audiobookshelf://oauth, code_challenge[, code_challenge_method=S256]) answers 302 with the same client_id, scope, random state and challenge plus redirect_uri=<request origin>/auth/openid/mobile-redirect, sets auth_method=openid-mobile and no auth_cb, and carries no token material. Two independent starts use different states and both callbacks create a session.
exceptions: Cookie field names and attributes are client-visible; the opaque connect.sid value and the Express session implementation are free.

invariants.contract: An unlisted mobile redirect_uri, an absent code_challenge, a code_challenge_method other than S256, a response_type other than code, or a state on the web flow each answer 400 without a Location, auth_cb/auth_method cookie or token material, and change no user or session. A web start whose callback is absent, cross-origin, protocol-relative, backslash-prefixed, outside the router base path, protocol-relative after percent-decoding, or not URL-decodable answers 400 with no Location, no auth_cb cookie and no user/session change. On a server whose OpenID settings are unset the route denies with a status >= 400 and no Location, auth cookie or token material.
exceptions: The unconfigured-settings denial is asserted as status >= 400 because no client calls /auth/openid while the provider settings are invalid.

invariants.contract: authOpenIDSubfolderForRedirectURLs is inserted verbatim before /auth/openid/callback and /auth/openid/mobile-redirect in the provider redirect_uri: the value /audiobookshelf yields <origin>/audiobookshelf/auth/openid/callback and <origin>/audiobookshelf/auth/openid/mobile-redirect, and restoring the empty setting yields the origin-only callback URL. A value that is not a valid URL prefix makes the native start answer an error status without a Location, auth cookie or user/session change.
exceptions: Only the /audiobookshelf value and the empty value are exercised; the setting is a caller-supplied URL prefix, not a validated list.
force is not applicable: GET /auth/openid has no force, override or refresh mode.
The exact upstream error text of denied starts is not asserted, only the 400 status and the absence of Location, auth cookies and credentials.
Mapping note: named internal Go tests are assertion leads only; the shared scenarios are the executable oracle.
